status: Frozen before head fitting; prior expression/embedding geometry already explored
label: 1 flight experiment; 0 matched ground. Not isolated radiation or gravity cause.
primary: Train on each study, test all samples of other study (two folds). Shared pools preclude independent-donor claim.
secondary: Within each study train one YA/OS donor pool, test other (four folds). No random chip CV.
preprocessing: Fixed shared observed-gene panel for expression; StandardScaler fitted to training rows only. PCA5 fitted on training rows only. Bridge mean and mean+std separately.
head: L2 logistic regression C=1, solver liblinear, max_iter=2000, random_state=17, threshold score0.5; no tuning or calibration
sensitivity: C=0.01 and C=100 cross-flight only; no winner selection. Leave-one-training-chip deletion at C=1 cross-flight only; descriptive sensitivity, not donor uncertainty.
attribution_gate: Do not promote BridgeRNA gene attributions if cross-flight prediction fails. Expression coefficients are model associations only.
limitations: Two flights and two donor pools, not 24 independent donors
Data already used for discovery; not pristine confirmation
Pretraining absence based only on supplied catalog
No train-test biological donor disjointness across flights asserted
execution: Local CPU, frozen cached embeddings; no encoder tuning, no VM or watcher
